text:
## Creative brief
Begin with Alex saying "let's get organised, let's have a plan", then immediately break that promise with a fast montage of items being thrown into the basket, cut to the beat. Set the scene early with the "peak travel experience: the supermarket" line. Midway, slow down for Ioanna's pickle negotiation, then pick the pace back up with "chips, chips, chips" and more throws. End at the cashier.

## Overview & Tone

This edit leans into comedic contrast: establishing an earnest, pseudo-philosophical travel vlog tone only to instantly shatter it with chaotic, fast-paced supermarket frenzy. The energy ebbs and flows dynamically, shifting from deadpan exposition to rhythmic, meme-accented rapid cuts, settling into a dialogue-driven comedic negotiation in the middle, and resolving on a snappy punchline at checkout. Visuals are tied together with bold, dark mustard animated subtitles highlighting spoken Greek words in real time.

## Story Beats

#### 1. The Illusion of a Plan (0:00–0:17) [node: beat_c4935935-e0d5-470f-a9da-3b5948dc8fec]

We open on Alex setting the stage with faux-serious intent using IMG_5408 [node: card_f0574ef0-fffc-408b-a005-aa696c19cd0d] (IMG_5408 (22.347233799438943s–27.390617636089804s)) ("let's get organised, let's have a plan"), supported by a measured, medium-paced visual setup [node: card_3d78172f-ea0c-4fc5-8593-928e9c6beacf]. We immediately jump into IMG_5407 [node: card_be77a854-24b7-4172-ab26-125095d7c23d] (IMG_5407 (19.6s–29.02s)), tightly trimmed to eliminate dead air while preserving his theatrical declaration that the local grocery store represents the pinnacle and epitome of tourism [node: card_50936901-59e5-4cb3-a7a6-e7a8718b14f0]. Alex then foreshadows the impending mayhem as he promises pure aisle chaos [node: card_74ab9d97-b783-4a4e-b36b-beace6968c5f] in the continuation of IMG_5407 [node: card_0ee7620c-b32b-4cb3-9a6b-6c47f116bf93] (IMG_5407 (32.34s–37.7s)), which bridges right into the montage. The entire opening dialogue is supported by dark mustard burned-in subtitles with word-by-word tracking [node: card_b8049824-b28e-4428-ad04-7375bf61408f].

#### 2. The Fast-Paced Basket Frenzy (0:17–0:29) [node: beat_70d183d0-cdc3-4f9a-a31a-a523c1aa712d]

Alex's chaos warning [node: card_0ee7620c-b32b-4cb3-9a6b-6c47f116bf93] (IMG_5407 (32.34s–37.7s)) explodes into a high-octane montage cut on rapid 1–2 second percussion hits [node: card_ed0881f8-5501-4909-a9fa-019acd9a63e7]. We whip through the grocery selection [node: card_22787514-ecb6-487d-811a-f43cd62d1c80] (IMG_5412 (13.66s–16.22s); IMG_5406 (1.73s–5.33s)), snapping from jars of instant coffee in IMG_5406 [node: card_8218d5b3-06c0-4a83-a7c1-a8d7a59c372b] directly into snatching cookies in IMG_5412 [node: card_bbb6309d-0bd5-499b-be55-837f96bd5209]. The haul escalates through the drinks and snacks sequence [node: card_ce51cf53-07ba-47df-8c9d-cb692132da80] (IMG_5416 (15.72s–17.4s); IMG_5415 (31.81s–34.47s); IMG_5412 (13.66s–16.22s)), tossing ready-made gin and tonic bottles from IMG_5415 [node: card_5b739809-1166-4c46-a1b8-80d0429834a4] and grabbing two-euro wine from IMG_5416 [node: card_21d9e0f7-be62-4497-9d68-6556118856e0]. In the middle of this mayhem, Giorgos kicks Sotos, which we punctuate with an over-the-top sound design hit [node: card_720cb98d-e2e0-4f6c-b116-459d8c5389ff], pulling a dramatic Vine boom bass drop [node: card_a3867314-2d0e-4df0-a538-5e5002ff799e] from the meme sound effects reel [node: card_2bac73ed-ea03-4817-8187-78189468ab7e] (projects/prj-alex/music/funny_meme_sound_effects.mp3 (use 2.0s–5.0s of the source — real stock audio file, use directly, do not generate a replacement)). Dynamic mustard subtitles continue to track every rapid-fire item callout [node: card_53c9d43e-9590-47d7-a72a-b9e1c0ec646a].

#### 3. The Pickle Negotiation (0:29–0:43) [node: beat_9613b275-448c-4936-9fc8-308e16fca970]

We abruptly downshift the frantic editing into a relaxed, observational comedy scene [node: card_4749f326-0080-4c0a-86e3-b38e8eee900d], backed by the mischievous swing of `playful_circus_loop.wav` [node: card_73ec0378-37f2-4edf-9634-75266d4bdb56] (projects/prj-alex/music/playful_circus_loop.wav (real stock audio file — use directly, do not generate a replacement)). The beat opens on the guys confronting Ioanna over her pickle hoard [node: card_3f179045-f2b8-4365-9b6d-18405e748745] in IMG_5418 [node: card_d14e3169-d9df-4648-bfaf-5b670791983d] (IMG_5418 (0s–2.64s)). We cut together the pickle jar debate group [node: card_11097070-4798-4ed1-a9a8-73754afb6ee8] (IMG_5418 (16.94s–20.76s); IMG_5418 (29.2s–33.42s)), letting Sotos lodge his petty complaint about jar sizes [node: card_69b3e177-63a2-402d-aa00-85cf4699a432], only for Ioanna and Alex to mock him and aggressively double down on two giant jars [node: card_940ae0b8-e282-464f-a6bc-3f1d2569d5b7]. Full Greek-to-English animated subtitles in mustard highlight the comedic banter throughout the dispute [node: card_ec565ad6-fb64-4e69-aa49-5bbcfa228d3f].

#### 4. Final Rush & Cashier Finish (0:43–0:55) [node: beat_a7c1ae5c-91a0-4583-b5b6-0fc5899dfa83]

The circus music cuts off as we snap straight back into high gear [node: card_04ea0820-065c-4935-9afd-95d50030fdd8] with an urgent last-second dash through the snack aisle in IMG_5413 [node: card_94e63606-2fe4-41de-a3fd-6730649ee473] (IMG_5413 (67.2s–69.02831756956111s)), yelling "περιμέντε, πατατάκια!" while snatching bags of chips. This rapid burst of momentum [node: card_f513faa0-b001-4cbb-9cdb-388da7b98136] crashes directly into the checkout register [node: card_a49a2587-7121-4bf1-8607-6c47ae666de6]. We land on a tightly trimmed selection of IMG_8591 [node: card_1ff78fcb-e494-4283-a453-7eb48bd0667a] (IMG_8591 (0.88s–15.24s)), ending on a clean, polite "Ευχαριστώ" as the spree concludes, giving the chaotic trip a satisfying, abrupt button.

## Constraints

- The plan above is the spec — it already made the editorial calls (what to use, what to omit, how to sequence and combine material). Follow the plan's own decisions rather than independently re-deriving them from first principles.
- Track is authoritative for whatever the plan places on a given track. A shot the plan describes as A-Roll must land on the A-Roll track, B-Roll on B-Roll, music on the Music track, and text/graphics on the Text/Graphics track. A card does not count as fulfilled merely because related material appears elsewhere in the timeline on the wrong track.
- Timecodes and durations in the plan are approximate targets, not exact requirements — use editorial judgment on the actual cut points, same as any real edit.
- A Music card whose source names a real file path (marked "real stock audio file") must be added directly with `edit-timeline add-clip <path> --row music --role music` — do not call `/generate music` for it.

## Instructions for tagging

When adding a clip with `edit-timeline add-clip`, attach the corresponding plan node ID using `--node-ids card_<id>` (or `beat_<id>` for a beat-level marker).

If one clip fulfills multiple plan node ids, include all applicable ones.

Only attach a node ID when the clip actually fulfills what the plan describes for it, including its named track. Use the exact node IDs from the plan. Do not invent or modify them.

## Completion requirements

Before finishing, verify against the plan's own decisions, not the original grid.

For each beat, confirm the edit the plan describes was actually realized: the right material landed on the right track, in the intended order, with any transitions/overlaps the plan called out.

For any node id the plan itself named as an intentionally unused alternative or backup, no further action is needed — that was already the plan's own decision, not something to silently reconsider or silently include anyway.

A node id that the plan actively describes using, but that never lands on the corresponding clip, is a real gap — note it and the reason in verification.
